resources.string: Asks for a goal when you open selected apps, reminds you of the time, and returns to the home screen when the session ends. Uses the package name of the active window. Screen text, passwords, and messages are not stored or transmitted.
Open apps with a purpose. Make time for what matters.
Enabled but not connected. Turn the service off and on again in Android settings.
Disabled — the goal form and widget are not active
The service detects the open app, shows your goal, and returns home when time runs out. Your data stays on your phone. Text inside other apps is not read.
Android 13+: if the switch is unavailable, open App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings. Names may differ on your phone.
If the service stops working, allow autostart and remove battery restrictions in your phone settings.
0 disables the warning. In silent mode, only the widget shows a warning.
Recent goals will be deleted. Active sessions will continue.
One specific task makes it easier to stop on time.
For example, reply to a friend
